text:
sara.cho: FYI final RN draft for v0.9.2 is uploaded to /docs/rn/v0.9.2.md — ready for internal review. Need pin decision and on-call standby for the 10:00 UTC change window.

mike.klein: Looking now. Can we tighten the 'rollback criteria' section? Ops wants clearer numeric thresholds rather than fuzzy language.

anika.ram: I can condense — will push an edited snippet in ~10m.

sara.cho: Thanks. Note: Dedicated customers may be affected by the quant change (model-quant-2 -> model-quant-v2). Plan is to pin the previous variant as a 2h fallback if we see issues.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @sara.cho for 2024-11-02T10:00:00Z — canary: 5% for 15m. Command:
```
/deploy -e prod -v v0.9.2 --canary=5 --monitoring=enabled
```

julian: Ops OK with that canary, but please set auto-rollback thresholds to conservative values: 5% error rate OR 2x latency baseline.

maya_ops: Standby assigned: maya_ops and sam_oncall (pager). I'll watch latency dashboards and will ping if p50 >1.5x baseline.

sara.cho: Anika — paste the trimmed rollback bullets here so I can include them verbatim in the RN before pinning.

anika.ram: ```
Rollback criteria:
- 5% request error rate sustained > 5m
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for > 10m
- model OOM / mismatch errors observed
Action: cut traffic to v0.9.1 (pinned), notify eng-oncall and customer success.
```

mike.klein: :thumbsup: That reads well. Add a note: 'temporary pin duration 2h, can extend with ops approval'.

sara.cho: Added that line. Tagging @eng on the internal announce thread once we finalize copy. Draft internal announcement below — pls quick check: 

sara.cho (draft):
Internal: Deploying v0.9.2 (quant update) to prod in the 10:00-10:30 UTC window. Canary 5% for 15m then ramp if healthy. Affected: Dedicated customers using model-quant-2. Rollback criteria are listed in the RN. Standby: maya_ops, sam_oncall. On rollback we will pin v0.9.1 for 2 hours as a fallback.

julian: Nit: change to '10:00-10:30 UTC window' (good), and add contact for private deploys (private-deploys@redwood).

maya_ops: Agree. Also add a reminder to update the #incidents channel topic if we roll back so CS sees it.

sara.cho: Done. I'll pin the RN and post the internal announce at T-30. Any objections?

mike.klein: None from me. :+1:

deploy-bot: Scheduled message: internal-announce will post at T-30 before 2024-11-02T10:00:00Z.

sam_oncall: I'll be on pager and monitoring. Ping me directly if traffic spikes or errors trend up.

product-bot: Note: Outreach plan for affected customers is in progress — CS will send targeted messages post-launch and if we trigger a rollback.

sara.cho: Closing loop — RN pinned, internal announcement scheduled. If anything changes I will update this thread. :rocket:
